The '''Deluxe Pirate Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained from [[Volcano Dungeon#Rare Chests|rare chests]] in the [[Volcano Dungeon]] (≈11.11% chance)<ref name="deluxepiratechance" />.

==Secret==
{{collapse|content= 
While wearing it, speaking to the bartender in the [[Ginger Island#Pirate Cove|Pirate Cove]] causes him to give the player [[mead]]. This can only be done once per night.}}
